Civil and Environmental Engineering Concentration
MS in Engineering (CEE concentration)
New Orleans and surrounding areas serve as a living laboratory for innovative teaching and research opportunities in various disciplines within Civil and Environmental Engineering (CEE) at LSU New Orleans. As the only CEE degree offering programs in southeast Louisiana, our degree offers the following advantages:
Earn a graduate degree in 18-24 months.
Flexible course offerings to fit your schedule.
Good job opportunities after graduation
Internship opportunities with reputable engineering firms.
Innovative and real-life research opportunities in advancement of science and engineering.
The Civil and Environmental Engineering (CEE) Department offers graduate level courses and research opportunities in the following areas:
Structural Engineering
Geotechnical Engineering
Environmental Engineering
Hydraulics and Water Resources Engineering
Coastal Engineering and Sciences
MS in Engineering degree options
The students have two options to obtain the MS in Engineering degree at LSU New Orleans. Details about the two options:
Thesis Option
24 credit hours of graduate-level coursework
6 credit hours of Master's thesis
Non-Thesis Option
27 credit hours graduate-level couresework
3 credit hours of master's project
Applicants without an undergraduate degree in Engineering
If the undergraduate degree is not in Civil Engineering or related field, the student will have to take foundation courses before he/she can be admitted as a degree seeking student in the Civil and Environmental Engineering program. Graduate Certificate in Coastal Engineering
The CEE department at LSU New Orleans also offers a graduate level certificate (Graduate Certificate in Coastal Engineering). The coastal certificate courses can be used towards the MS in Engineering degree. Information regarding course offerings, academic requirements, application procedure, deadlines etc. can be found at ceas.uno.edu.
Have additional Questions?
For additional information, please contact the CEE Graduate Coordinator (Dr. Satish Bastola, [email protected]) and schedule an appointment to discuss your graduate curriculum.
